desc:
Welcome to Universe Keyboard Escape!, an exciting obby inspired by the world of giant keyboards! Your goal is simple: escape the keyboard by completing challenging stages filled with jumps, obstacles, and surprises. Every stage becomes more difficul
🏆 Earn Wins by progressing through the game and use them to skip difficult stages if you get stuck. Can you reach the final stage and prove you're the ultimate keyboard escape champion?

🌟 Features
🎮 Unique keyboard-themed obby.
🏃 Dozens of fun and challenging stages.
🏆 Earn Wins while playing.
⏩ Skip stages using your Wins.
💾 Automatic progress saving.
👥 Play together with your friends.
📱 Mobile, PC, and Tablet support.
🔄 Frequent updates with new stages, improvements, and surprises.
💡 Tips
Be careful—some jumps are harder than they look!
Save your Wins for the toughest stages.
Invite your friends and see who can reach the end first.
❤️ If you enjoy the game, please:
👍 Like the game.
⭐ Favorite it.
🔔 Follow for future updates.
